brief: STEP 1 of the Paper C polish (author brief 2026-08-30): fix the renderer's mode collapse by changing DECODING ONLY -- no retraining -- and re-measure diversity, triangulation, faithfulness and the C4B translation cost.
cell: target/concept_hot/A (the 42 blend targets, concept channel, adapter A)

sample_T0.7.note: PRIMARY, one sample, no selection at all

sample_T1.0.note: PRIMARY (second declared cell), one sample, no selection at all

bestofk_lm.note: SECONDARY: k=8 samples, argmax LENGTH-NORMALISED LM sequence log-likelihood. The picker never sees the tower, the cosine, R_s or any evaluation quantity.

decoding_spec.reproducibility: the sampled arms are reproducible from (seed, gen_batch): torch.multinomial consumes the generator's stream per batch, so the batch is pinned to the whole 42-state population (one batch) and asserted
decoding_spec.pick_rule_blind_to_evaluation: bestofk_lm picks by LENGTH-NORMALISED LM sequence log-likelihood, computed from the frozen LM's own unmodified logits inside generate_arm(). It never sees the tower, the re-encode cosine, R_s, any NDCG, or any other evaluation quantity.
decoding_spec.declared_choice_bestofk_proposal: the k=8 candidates are drawn at T=1.0 / top-p 0.9, the same sampler the primary arm uses (the brief fixes k and the pick rule, not the proposal temperature)
decoding_spec.empty_generation_rule: C4_PILOT.md ruling 1: an empty generation is NOT a rendering -- declared non-encodable, never SBERT-selected, never folded, cos NaN, and in the noise arm it asks NOTHING (that state's arm degenerates to the m=0 base). Counted per arm, never silently dropped.

what_changed: DECODING ONLY. The adapter (c3b_true_best.pt), the tower bridge, R_s, the SBERT recipe, the declared-circular answer model, the certified fold and genv_eval are all IMPORTED and unchanged. Arms L, P and T' are unchanged.

baseline_reproduction.note: the greedy arm is regenerated rather than read, precisely so the comparison is against a REPRODUCTION of the published row; both the texts and their cosines are asserted against the bank

triangulation.unique_vs_repeated_rule: UNIQUE = the render text occurs exactly once among the arm's 42 renders; REPEATED = it occurs more than once. On the greedy arm this reproduces C4_PILOT.md's 18 unique / 24 stock-word split exactly.
triangulation.own_concept_rule: c4_triangulate's: exact genome-tag match on the normalised render if the render IS a tag, else the render's TOP SBERT concept

answer_model.rule: answer(r, c) = sign(u*_r . d_c), +-1, refusal never simulated
answer_model.u_star: fold_items_frozen(ctx.enc, ctx.allb[r]) -- the env's own full fold-in profile latent, identical in construction to answer_contrast.u_star
answer_model.note: the certified fold's cap_negatives over the REVEALED set still applies, so a user answering k of the 4 concepts negatively folds them at -min(1, c_neg/k) rather than -1. It is the env's own certified operator and it is applied identically in all four arms.

arm_definitions.L: top-4 concepts by cos(d_c, R_s) in tower space, ties by concept id (no text) -- UNCHANGED from C4B
arm_definitions.T_<arm>: SBERT top-4 (mincos 0.30) of adapter A's concept-hot render of the m=5 blend target under that DECODING arm
arm_definitions.Tprime: the banked scrambled-twin render -- UNCHANGED from C4B (greedy A')
arm_definitions.P: the banked channel-matched prior-only text -- UNCHANGED from C4B

declared_choices.base_is_m0_no_fold: as C4B: the arms are scored against the m=0 (no-fold) intercept on the state's own cohort; the interview PREFIX is not folded in any arm. Arm-symmetric.
declared_choices.ask_order: ascending concept id within an arm, as C4B. Arm-symmetric.
declared_choices.prior_text_arm: the banked concept-hot prior-only text, identical for all 42 states

bootstrap.per_state: paired percentile over the state's own user-rows
bootstrap.summary: stratified: users resampled WITHIN state, states fixed, weight = cohort size (the pooled user-row mean)
bootstrap.nesting_caveat: the 42 states are nested; the summary treats states as independent strata and therefore UNDERSTATES its interval. The per-state rows are the primary object.
bootstrap.render_level_bootstrap: the diversity / triangulation / faithfulness rows resample the 42 STATES (c3b_adapter.boot_mean)

reference.definition: R_s = sum_j w_j * tower(q_j) over the state's banked m=5 ingredients (c4_pilot.reference_directions, IMPORTED)

disclosure.note: Ew rows carry their own magnitude, d_c rows are unit -- so in a mixed blend the nominal weight is not the effective one. Reported, not corrected: R_s is defined by the sheet in exactly these two objects.

render_provenance.regeneration_note: all four decoding arms are generated here; the greedy arm is asserted identical to the bank

what_may_not_be_claimed: no absolute 'asking it helps' claim (the AUTHOR RULING 2026-08-25 keeps the fatal use closed); nothing about the item channel; nothing from emission renders (retracted); no generalisation beyond the 42 nested, structurally-selected states
